Year's Eve, when from previous experience she anticipated a fit of depression so intense that nothing could possibly serve to augment it. arxiv-2101-04578.title: Toward the endoscopic classification of unipotent representations of p p -adic G 2 G_{2} Thanks: Clifton Cunningham gratefully acknowledges the support of NSERC Discovery Grant RGPIN-2020-05220 Thanks: Andrew Fiori thanks and acknowledges both the University of Lethbridge for their financial support
arxiv-2101-04578.creator: Clifton Cunningham, Andrew Fiori, Qing Zhang
arxiv-2101-04578.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Clifton Cunningham, Andrew Fiori, Qing Zhang. We begin this paper by reviewing the Langlands correspondence for unipotent representations of the exceptional group of type G 2 G_{2} over a p p -adic field F F and present it in an explicit form. Then we compute all ABV-packets, as defined in [ 9 ] following ideas from Vogan’s 1993 paper The local Langlands Conjecture , and prove that these packets satisfy properties derived from the expectation that they are generalized A-packets.

arxiv-2101-10290.title: Fundamental solutions and Hadamard states for a scalar field with arbitrary boundary conditions on an asymptotically AdS spacetimes
arxiv-2101-10290.creator: Claudio Dappiaggi, Alessio Marta
arxiv-2101-10290.description: Abstract We consider the Klein-Gordon operator on an n n -dimensional asymptotically anti-de Sitter spacetime ( M , g ) (M,g) together with arbitrary boundary conditions encoded by a self-adjoint pseudodifferential operator on ∂ M \partial M of order up to 2 2 .

arxiv-2104-00342.title: Intuitive Tasks Planning Using Visuo-Tactile Perception for Human Robot Cooperation
arxiv-2104-00342.creator: Sunny Katyara, Fanny Ficuciello, Tao Teng, Fei Chen, Bruno Siciliano, Darwin G. Caldwell
arxiv-2104-00342.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sunny Katyara, Fanny Ficuciello, Tao Teng, Fei Chen, Bruno Siciliano, Darwin G. Caldwell. Designing robotic tasks for co-manipulation necessitates to exploit not only proprioceptive but also exteroceptive information for improved safety and autonomy. Following such instinct, this research proposes to formulate intuitive robotic tasks following human viewpoint by incorporating visuo-tactile perception. The visual data using depth cameras surveils and determines the object dimensions and human intentions while the tactile sensing ensures to maintain the desired contact to avoid slippage.

arxiv-2305-08060.title: Two is Better Than One: Digital Siblings to Improve Autonomous Driving Testing Journal: EMSE
arxiv-2305-08060.creator: Matteo Biagiola, Andrea Stocco, Vincenzo Riccio, Paolo Tonella
arxiv-2305-08060.description: Abstract Simulation-based testing represents an important step to ensure the reliability of autonomous driving software. In practice, when companies rely on third-party general-purpose simulators, either for in-house or outsourced testing, the generalizability of testing results to real autonomous vehicles is at stake.

arxiv-2305-09232.title: A Cuntz–Krieger Uniqueness Theorem for C ∗ C^{*} -algebras of relative generalized Boolean dynamical systems
arxiv-2305-09232.creator: Toke Meier Carlsen, Eun Ji Kang
arxiv-2305-09232.description: Abstract . We prove a version of the Cuntz–Krieger Uniqueness Theorem for C ∗ C^{*} -algebras of arbitrary relative generalized Boolean dynamical systems. We then describe properties of a C ∗ C^{*} -algebra of a relative generalized Boolean dynamical system when the underlying Boolean dynamical system satisfies Condition (K).

arxiv-2308-07402.title: Energy Efficiency of Quantum Statevector Simulation at Scale CCS: Hardware Impact on the environment CCS: Applied computing Physics CCS: Theory of computation Quantum computation theory CCS: Computing methodologies Parallel computing methodologies
arxiv-2308-07402.creator: Jakub Adamski, James Peter Richings, Oliver Thomson Brown
arxiv-2308-07402.description: Abstract . Classical simulations are essential for the development of quantum computing, and their exponential scaling can easily fill any modern supercomputer. In this paper we consider the performance and energy consumption of large Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) simulations run on ARCHER2, the UK’s National Supercomputing Service, with QuEST toolkit.

arxiv-2504-17096.title: Sailor: Automating Distributed Training over Dynamic, Heterogeneous, and Geo-distributed Clusters
arxiv-2504-17096.creator: Foteini Strati, Zhendong Zhang, George Manos, Ixeia Sánchez Périz, Qinghao Hu, Tiancheng Chen, Berk Buzcu, Song Han, Pamela Delgado, Ana Klimovic
arxiv-2504-17096.description: Abstract . The high GPU demand of ML training makes it hard to allocate large homogeneous clusters of high-end GPUs in a single availability zone. Leveraging heterogeneous GPUs available within and across zones can improve throughput at a reasonable cost.

arxiv-2505-20525.title: MultLFG: Training-free Multi-LoRA composition using Frequency-domain Guidance
arxiv-2505-20525.creator: Aniket Roy, Maitreya Suin, Ketul Shah, Rama Chellappa, Johns Hopkins University, Samsung AI Center Toronto
arxiv-2505-20525.description: Abstract Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has gained prominence as a computationally efficient method for fine-tuning generative models, enabling distinct visual concept synthesis with minimal overhead. However, current methods struggle to effectively merge multiple LoRA adapters without training, particularly in complex compositions involving diverse visual elements.

arxiv-2512-16560.title: On the Codebook Design for NOMA Schemes from Bent Functions
arxiv-2512-16560.creator: Chunlei Li, Constanza Riera, Palash Sarkar, Pantelimon Stănică
arxiv-2512-16560.description: Abstract Uplink grant-free non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) is a promising technology for massive connectivity with low latency and high energy efficiency. In code-domain NOMA schemes, the requirements boil down to the design of codebooks that contain a large number of spreading sequences with low peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) while maintaining low coherence.

pmc-10647058.title: Multisensory stimulation bundles on sleep and neurobehavioral development in the first year after birth in very preterm infants: a randomized crossover controlled study protocol
pmc-10647058.creator: Xiaoli Tang, Sha Sha, Nanping Shen, Zhiyu Zhu, Yanmin Qin, Junyi Shen, Fei Bei
pmc-10647058.description: BackgroundDisrupted sleep is believed to contribute to short- and long-term neurodevelopmental problems in very preterm infants (VPIs). This study presents a protocol for an evaluator-blinded, randomized crossover trial. It aims to assess the sleep efficiency of hospitalized VPIs by providing multisensory stimulation bundles.

pmc-11355037.title: Educommunication in Nutrition and Neurodegenerative Diseases: A Scoping Review
pmc-11355037.creator: Karla Mônica Dantas Coutinho, Sancha Helena de Lima Vale, Manacés dos Santos Bezerril, Mônica Karina Santos Reis, Almudena Muñoz Gallego, Karilany Dantas Coutinho, Ricardo Valentim, Lucia Leite-Lais, Kenio Costa de Lima
pmc-11355037.description: Neurodegenerative diseases significantly impact individuals’ nutritional status. Therefore, nutritional education plays a crucial role in enhancing the understanding of food and nutrition, preventing or minimizing malnutrition, promoting well-being, and empowering patients and caregivers. Educommunication is a methodology that utilizes communication as a pedagogical tool, with the potential to positively enhance the teaching–learning process.

pmc-11431773.title: Food Delivery Apps and Their Potential to Address Food Insecurity in Older Adults: A Review
pmc-11431773.creator: Sangchul Hwang, Cassandra M Johnson, Joni Charles, Lesli Biediger-Friedman, Jimmy T Efird, Paul B Tchounwou
pmc-11431773.description: The proportion of older adults is increasing globally, yet many of them experience food insecurity. Technological innovations, such as increased access to internet- and mobile-based food delivery apps (FDAs), may help mitigate food insecurity. However, this topic has been understudied.

pmc-12397007.title: Physical correlation between stochasticity and process-induced damage in ferroelectric memory devices
pmc-12397007.creator: Ryun-Han Koo, Seungwhan Kim, Jiseong Im, Sangwoo Ryu, Kangwook Choi, Sung-Ho Park, Jonghyun Ko, Jongho Ji, Mingyun Oh, Jangsaeng Kim, Gyuweon Jung, Sung-Tae Lee, Daewoong Kwon, Wonjun Shin, Jong-Ho Lee
pmc-12397007.description: This study investigates the influence of sputtering plasma-induced damage on stochastic characteristics in HfZrO₂ (HZO)-based ferroelectric tunnel junctions (FTJs), with an emphasis on memory and neuromorphic device optimization. Variation of the sputtering plasma power during top electrode deposition introduces distinct levels of trap within the HZO layer.

pmc-12470540.title: Effect of Visual Field Test on Intraocular Pressure in Glaucoma Patients
pmc-12470540.creator: Weon Jin Jang, Han Jun Chung, Min Woo Lee, Jung Tae Kim, Hyung-Bin Lim, Kee Sup Park
pmc-12470540.description: Objectives: To evaluate changes in intraocular pressure (IOP) before versus after a visual field test in glaucoma patients. Methods: A total of 132 patients with glaucoma and 103 control subjects who visited Konyang University Hospital between August 2024 and May 2025 were included in the study. the right eye of each patient was selected for analysis.

pmc-12689515.title: Intergroup relations and dynamics of (dis)integration between youth with immigrant and non-immigrant origins: a scoping review
pmc-12689515.creator: Katja Lötjönen, Hadi Farahani, Jari Martikainen, Marlen Nissinen
pmc-12689515.description: In light of growing societal diversity, gaining a deeper understanding of intergroup relations is increasingly crucial for fostering inclusive and cohesive communities. This scoping review synthesizes research on immigrant and non-immigrant young people’s perceptions and experiences of intergroup relations and (dis)integration.

pmc-13124693.title: Shared molecular features and potential diagnostic biomarkers between ulcerative colitis and sarcopenia: an integrative bioinformatics analysis with preliminary experimental validation
pmc-13124693.creator: Beiying Deng, Yinghui Liu, Pengzhan He, Nian Wang, Lin Xu, Jingjing Ma
pmc-13124693.description: Sarcopenia and ulcerative colitis (UC) may share potential biological links through mechanisms involving immune dysregulation, gut microbiota imbalance, and inflammatory pathway activation. This study aimed to identify fatty acid metabolism-related shared genes between UC and sarcopenia. A total of 277 shared differentially expressed genes (sDEGs) were identified, which were mainly enriched in immune-, inflammation-, and metabolism-related pathways.

pmc-13436819.title: Experiences and perceptions of IBD-related psychological distress in persons living with IBD
pmc-13436819.creator: Natalie Willett, Courtney Heisler, Noelle Rohatinsky, Sophie Farina, Michael Stewart, Tiffany Shepherd, Barbara Currie, Kelly Phalen, Jessica Robar, Thea Huard, Emily Neil, Jennifer L Jones
pmc-13436819.description: BackgroundIBD-related psychological distress (IBD-PD) refers to the emotional impact of IBD and is associated with increased IBD activity. The inability to provide high-quality, person-centred care for IBD-PD that is proportional to clinical need is a significant healthcare gap in the Canadian healthcare system.

pmc-13519002.creator: Miao Shi, Peipei Li, Quanjin Li, Chao Ning, Sen Yin, Yina Gao, Yong Wang, Jingyu Li, Zhaolong Li, Songqing Liu, Dong Li, Changwei Wei, Ang Gao

pmc-13546011.title: The Global, Regional, and National Burden of Postpartum Hemorrhage, 1990–2040: A Systematic Analysis Based on the Global Burden of Disease Study
pmc-13546011.creator: Jianhua Sun, Yuanyuan Wang, Huafang Wei
pmc-13546011.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPostpartum hemorrhage (PPH) remains one of the leading global causes of maternal morbidity and mortality. To date, however, comprehensive long-term epidemiological trends and standardized future projections of PPH burden stratified by socioeconomic level have not been sufficiently characterized.
